title: Udyam registration vs GST registration
summary: Two different registrations: what each one is for.

sections.heading: They are different
paragraphs: Udyam registration is for MSME recognition. GST registration is for tax. One does not replace the other.

sections.heading: Udyam registration
paragraphs: It is done on the Udyam portal. Read our Udyam guide for more.

sections.heading: GST registration
paragraphs: You need it when your sales cross a limit. The limits are in the box above.

sections.heading: Which do you need?
paragraphs: It depends on your business. Ask your CA.
